wu: Letter Sound Relay: Students line up in two teams. Teacher calls out a letter (A-F), one student from each team runs to the board, writes the letter, and says its sound and word (e.g., 'A is for apple!'). First team with correct letter, sound, and word gets a point.
wuAlt: Flashcard Jump: Students jump when they see the flashcard for the letter sound called out, shouting the sound and word.
Alphabet Bingo: Teacher calls out letter sounds, students cover the corresponding letter on their bingo cards.
pres: Teacher shows Thanksgiving-themed flashcards (apple, bread, cheese, drum, egg, fish) for letters A-F. Models each letter-sound link: 'A is for apple, /æ/.' Students repeat. Introduces digraphs 'ch', 'sh', 'th' with picture cards (cheese, fish, thumb), modeling the sounds and words. Checks understanding by asking 'What sound does this make?' for each digraph.
presAlt: Story Time: Teacher reads a short Thanksgiving story with target words, pausing to emphasize sounds. Students repeat the words.
Mystery Bag: Students reach into a bag to find an object starting with A-F or containing ch/sh/th, say the word, and identify the sound.
prac: Pair Dictation: Students work in pairs. One student says a word (e.g., 'thumb'), the other writes it. They check their spelling using a code on the board (A=apple, B=bread, etc.). Teacher circulates to support pronunciation and spelling.
pracAlt: Digraph Sort: Students sort picture cards into three boxes labeled 'ch', 'sh', 'th' as a group activity.
Word Relay: Teams race to write ch/sh/th words on the board when the teacher shows a picture.
ls: Phonics Song: Students listen to a Thanksgiving phonics song focusing on ch/sh/th sounds. They stand up when they hear the target sounds and point to the correct digraph flashcard on the wall.
re: Sound Jump: After the break, students jump on numbered spots on the floor. Teacher calls out a word (e.g., 'cheese'), students jump on the number corresponding to the sound (1=ch, 2=sh, 3=th).
prod: Gratitude Turkey Craft: Each student makes a paper turkey. For each feather, they write one sentence: 'I am thankful for...' using target words (e.g., 'I am thankful for cheese.'). They present their turkey to the class.
rw: Digraph Word Search: Students find and circle 3 ch/sh/th words in a simple word search puzzle. Then, they copy the words into their notebooks, writing each word three times.
st: Thanksgiving Story: Teacher reads a short story about a thankful turkey, emphasizing target sounds. Students repeat key words. Goodbye routine: Sing 'Goodbye Song', update sticker chart, and line up for high-fives.
g: Students cover letters on their bingo cards when the teacher calls out a sound.
Teams race to match picture cards to the correct digraph on the board.
Students take turns saying a thankful sentence with a target word.
Students hop on squares labeled with ch/sh/th words, saying the sound as they land.
Students pass a turkey plush while saying a thankful sentence; stop when music plays.
diff: Fast finishers: Write a short thankful story using 5 target words.
Support: Use word banks with pictures for the turkey craft.
hw: Read the phonics page in your mini-book and circle 3 new words.
Say 3 'I am thankful for...' sentences at home to your family.
Draw a picture of your favorite Thanksgiving food and label it with its sound.
tip: Use Moroccan context by linking gratitude to local traditions like sharing with neighbors during Ramadan or celebrating the Green March.
